findings.message: The updated prompt narrows invoke-leak detection to `CompositionRoot` methods and adds no category for a public free function in `cli_composition`. ADR 2026-07-23-0111 explicitly identifies the former `run_greeting` public free function as a violation of the R1 `FreeFunction` restriction; a reviewer following this prompt could miss an equivalent free-function composition entry point if it does not expose a prohibited type. Add an explicit prohibition/category for public free functions in `cli_composition` (or broaden the invoke/public-surface rule accordingly).

The revised invoke-leak category applies only to `CompositionRoot` methods, so it no longer covers a public free function in `cli_composition` that invokes an interactor or `PrimaryAdapter`. ADR 2026-07-23-0111 identifies `run_greeting`-style public free functions as violations, and R1 forbids `FreeFunction` in this layer. Broaden this category or add an explicit public-free-function prohibition.

`CompositionRootPureDi` inspects only methods. Public fields are ignored, so a root with `pub interactor: GreetUser` and a valid driver accessor passes despite exposing an internal role. AC-04 requires these public-surface exposures to be detected.

The signature scan includes only parameters and the return type, omitting method generic bounds and where-predicates. For example, a zero-argument PrimaryAdapter accessor constrained by `usecase::ApplicationService` passes while exposing a prohibited usecase role.

`collect_methods_for_type` covers only `TypeEntry.methods` and inherent impls. Methods supplied through catalogue `trait_impls` are never evaluated, allowing a CompositionRoot to implement an ApplicationService trait with a request-to-result method without triggering this rule.

The constructor exemption accepts only exact `new() -> Self`, while the role scan permits only PrimaryAdapter. Consequently valid fallible wiring APIs such as `new() -> Result<Self, CompositionError>` and `driver() -> Result<Driver, CompositionError>` are rejected, despite the composition policy requiring typed wiring errors to propagate. Composition-local errors must remain permitted while usecase errors stay prohibited.

The new fallible `CatalogueLinterRule::new` branch is untested: every `CompositionRootPureDi` test supplies exactly `[CompositionRoot]`. Add an error-path test proving that an empty/all-role or wrong-role target returns `InvalidRuleConfig`, as required for public APIs.

CompositionRoot の型自体に宣言された generic bounds / where predicates が検査されていません。現在は公開フィールドと各メソッドの型だけを走査するため、例えば `pub struct GreetingCompositionRoot<T> where T: usecase::ApplicationService` は禁止された usecase ロールを公開型表面に露出していても通過します。`TypeEntry::generics()` と `TypeEntry::where_predicates()`（併せて必要なら inherent impl の制約）も同じロール検査へ含めてください。

`public_field_types` が enum と type alias を無条件に空として扱うため、CompositionRoot の enum variant payload や alias target にある禁止ロールを見逃します。例えば `type GreetingCompositionRoot = usecase::GreetUser`、または variant が `usecase::GreetUser` を保持する enum は違反なしになります。variant payload / alias target を走査するか、CompositionRoot を struct に限定して不正な形を拒否してください。

trait impl と trait entry の `Reference` を除外しているため、既存 trait を実装する CompositionRoot の公開実行メソッドを検査できません。カタログでは既存の trait/impl が `Reference` で表現され得るので、root が `Modify` された場合でも、参照された `ApplicationService` trait の `execute` 等が丸ごと抜けて AC-04 を迂回します。参照 entry に保持された method surface も検査するか、情報不足時は workspace trait impl を fail-closed で扱ってください。

`is_wiring_constructor` が引数なしの `new` だけを constructor と認識するため、`new(repo_root: PathBuf) -> Self` のような正当な object-graph 構築 API も line 227 で execution method と誤判定されます。ADR D1 が禁止するのは request-to-result 実行であり、配線用入力を受ける constructor ではありません。receiver/name/Self-return で constructor を識別し、引数型の禁止 role 検査は別途維持してください。

CompositionRoot に属する trait impl について、実装 trait の method しか検査せず、`trait_ref` と impl-level generics / where predicates を公開面として検査していません。そのため method を持たない `impl usecase::ApplicationService for GreetingCompositionRoot` や `impl External<usecase::GreetUser> ...` が禁止 role を露出しても通過します。`TraitImplDeclV2` の trait reference、generic bounds、where predicates も role 検査へ含めてください。

trait impl の self type を `bare_name_in_type_ref` で包含一致させているため、`impl SomeTrait for Wrapper<GreetingCompositionRoot>` まで `GreetingCompositionRoot` 自身の impl として扱われます。trait に引数付き method があれば、適合している root に架空の execution-method 違反が発生します。`for_type` は既存の `has_trait_impl` と同様、型名の完全一致または root 自身の generic self type のみに限定してください。

execution-method 判定が、constructor 以外では引数が 1 つでもあれば無条件に違反とするため、`driver(&self, items_dir: PathBuf) -> TaskContractDriver` のように配線用設定を受け取り fully-wired PrimaryAdapter を返す純 DI builder も拒否されます。CN-01 が禁止する request-to-result 実行とは異なるため、PrimaryAdapter を返し、引数にも禁止 role を露出しない wiring method は通過できるよう判定してください。

trait method surface は `all_catalogues` 内で trait entry を解決できた場合にしか追加されません。したがって、カタログに宣言のない `external::Runner` を CompositionRoot が実装し、その trait が `run(request) -> result` を公開していても、`TraitImplDeclV2` 自体には method 情報がないため違反なしで通過します。未解決の trait impl を黙って無視せず、既知の非実行 trait を限定的に許可するか、method surface を解決できない場合は fail-closed にしてください。

未解決の trait impl を一律違反にしたため、`core::default::Default` や `core::fmt::Debug` のような正常な標準 trait も拒否されます。これらは CompositionRoot の catalogue で実際に trait_impl として記録されますが、DDD の `TraitEntry` ではないため `all_catalogues` から解決できません。結果として Default を実装した Add/Modify root は純 DI でも AC-04 を通過できません。既知の非実行・構造的 trait を閉じた許可集合で扱い、未解決の任意 behavioral trait だけを fail-closed にしてください。

wiring constructor の認識が method 名 `new` に固定されているため、`try_new(config) -> Result<Self, CompositionError>` や `from_config(config) -> Self` のような正当な構築 API が execution method と誤判定されます。ADR/spec は constructor 名を制約していないため、receiver のない Self／fallible Self 返却を名前に依存せず constructor surface として判定し、引数の禁止 role 検査は維持してください。

未解決 trait の許可集合が構造 trait だけに固定されているため、`impl TryFrom<PathBuf> for GreetingCompositionRoot` や `impl From<Config> ...` のような標準の構築 trait も違反になります。これらの method surface はそれぞれ `try_from(input) -> Result<Self, _>` / `from(input) -> Self` に固定され、既に許可されている associated constructor と同じ純 DI の構築 API です。trait generic 引数への禁止 role 検査は維持しつつ、`core`/`std::convert::{From, TryFrom}` を constructor trait として扱うか、その既知 method surface を評価してください。

D5 embeds an exhaustive lint schema, phase wiring, grandfathering behavior, and residual-risk boundary inside the ADR, obscuring the architectural decision. Move these operational details to the relevant convention/capability SSoT and retain only the decision to enforce the public-face rule via catalogue lint.

D3 treats any other-layer type on the composition public surface as a violation, but D1/D2 require that surface to return the wired `GreetDriver` from `cli_driver`. The mandated pure-DI API would therefore violate its own review category. Narrow the category to forbidden domain/usecase/internal-role exposure while explicitly permitting the returned `PrimaryAdapter`.
findings.category: inconsistent decisions within the same ADR

findings.message: D5 embeds operational lint schema/configuration and enforcement details in the ADR, including concrete convention/config paths and preset ownership. This obscures the architectural decision and leaks downstream gate/lint implementation concerns into the ADR; delegate those mechanics to the referenced convention/config SSoTs while retaining only the high-level choice of enforcement mechanism.

T001 description restates the upstream behavior contract (“add passing and failing regression cases for execution methods and prohibited public-surface role exposure” and “approved catalogue-lint enforcement boundary”) instead of limiting the plan text to target, operation, and anchor cite. See knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md.

T002 description restates the upstream review-policy behavior contract, including which calls and exposed types are deviations and that a fully wired PrimaryAdapter is allowed. See knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md.

T003 description restates the upstream composition-root and CLI behavior contract (“fully wired adapter,” “parse, obtain, handle, emit,” validation placement, and prohibited types). See knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md.
The T001 plan summary restates the upstream pure-DI public-surface rationale rather than providing only implementation sequencing context and the task anchor.
The T002 plan summary restates the upstream composition-deviation behavior contract rather than limiting the summary to sequencing and task attribution.
The T003 plan summary restates the upstream positive-example behavior and migration-boundary rationale rather than limiting the summary to sequencing and task attribution.
The enforcement section description restates the pure-DI public-surface behavior contract instead of stating only the target operation and anchor.
The review-policy section description restates the deviation and allowance behavior contract instead of stating only the target operation and anchor.
The shipped-positive-example section description restates the migration-boundary rationale instead of stating only the target operation and anchor.

T001 is attributed to catalogue entries `CatalogueLinterRule` and `LintRuleKind`, but its executable description only names `CatalogueLinterRuleKind` and `evaluate_catalogue_lint` as targets. Either name the two attributed entries in T001’s description or remove the unjustified attributions.

`plan.summary` only describes task ordering and never maps GO-01 to any task. Goal traceability must live in this field because `task-coverage.json` cannot represent goals; add an explicit GO-01 → task mapping.

T002 names only “the `apps/cli-composition` review-policy checks”; that is a source directory, not the policy file or a concrete symbol/section to edit. The executor must discover the actual boundary. Name `.harness/custom/review-prompts/cli_composition.md` and the categories/checks to update.

T003 is the sole mapping for IN-04 and AC-05, but its only operation updates the shipped greeting placeholder. It neither records nor verifies the existing internal composition-facade deviation and opportunistic-migration policy, so these mappings are implausible despite the anchor citations.

T003 is the sole carrier for AC-01 and AC-02 but includes no validation step for the changed CompositionRoot, PrimaryAdapter, or CLI flow. Migrating or adding the relevant wiring, happy/error-path, and command-flow regression tests is therefore hidden work; identify those checks in the task.

T002 restates IN-02/AC-03 in prose with “flag both interactor and driver invocation,” the prohibited type list, and the PrimaryAdapter exception. Per `knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md`, retain only the target file, an operation such as updating its priority categories, and the existing anchor citations.

T003 restates IN-01, CN-01/CN-02, and AC-01/AC-02 through the required return value, validation placement, adapter signature, and parse-to-emit sequence, then restates IN-04/CN-04/AC-05 and OUT-01. Reduce it to the named files/symbols, the update and regression-test operations, and anchor citations as required by `knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md`.

Section `review-policy` repeats the behavioral contract for execution-method detection, prohibited public exposure, and the PrimaryAdapter exception. Its description must use target + operation + anchors instead of restating IN-02/AC-03; cite `knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md`.

Section `shipped-positive-example` repeats the pure-DI flow and the internal-facade deviation/migration contract, including the no-big-bang boundary. Replace that prose with the concrete targets, update/test/verification operations, and existing anchors; cite `knowledge/conventions/no-upstream-restatement.md`.
